description: Held-out hard evaluation set: 30 short, vague, misspelled or code-mixed narratives written in phrasings different from the synthetic generator templates. Written before the first evaluation run and NOT used to tune the mapper. Ground truth is the team's judgement; some items are genuinely ambiguous between welding QPs.
